summary: Addex Therapeutics Ltd. filed a routine Form 6-K on September 28, 2026, furnishing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements and management discussion for the period ended June 30, 2026, plus a press release dated the same day. The Swiss foreign private issuer incorporated Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 by reference into its existing Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or special-situation event is disclosed in the excerpt; this is ordinary periodic reporting, with no deal terms to assess.
